name: liftover
description: Lift over genomic coordinates between genome assembly versions (hg19/GRCh37 ↔ hg38/GRCh38)
usage: from app.tools.biomni.genetics import liftover; result = liftover([{'chrom': 'chr1', 'pos': 1000000}, {'chrom': 'chr2', 'pos': 2000000}], from_build='hg19', to_build='hg38')

parameters.positions: list — list of dicts with keys: chrom (e.g. 'chr1'), pos (int)

returns: dict with keys: from_build, to_build, total, converted_count, failed_count, results (list with new_chrom, new_pos), failed
